title: An Active Learning Framework for Inclusive Generation by Large Language Models
findings: The proposed active learning framework, particularly the clustering-based approach (Cluster-AL), significantly reduces the error rates and error-ratio-variance when generating counter-narratives for hate speech targeting religious groups (Muslims and Jews). This indicates that the method produces more accurate and consistent (less biased) outputs for these groups compared to standard fine-tuning and non-clustering active learning.

measurement_description: The benchmark measures the effectiveness and inclusivity of generating counter-narratives for hate speech. Specifically for religion, it evaluates the model's performance in countering hate speech directed at Muslims and Jews, measuring error rates and the variance of these errors across different targeted groups.
